 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Golden State Warriors try to bounce back when they take on the San Antonio Spurs in NBA Cup action on Friday. The game begins at 9:30 PM ET and will air on Amazon Prime, WOAI 2, and DAZN-SAS.
 The Warriors saw their eight-game win streak snapped in their last game as they fell to the Houston Rockets, 115-108. They are 8-4 on the season, 6th in the West. This is their second game on a five-game road trip.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement After losing their first two games of the season, the Spurs have won ten straight contests. They are coming off a 124-119 victory over the Chicago Bulls and are 10-2 on the year, putting them 2nd in the West. This is a quick trip home after a four-game road trip.
 This is the first of three meetings between the two teams.
 Golden State Warriors Injury Report
 Stephen Curry is OUT with a right oblique tear. He suffered the injury six minutes into the game against the Rockets. On November 12, it was reported that he will miss close to one month.
 Brandon Williams is OUT with a left hamstring strain. He missed the last game against the Rockets. On November 10, it was reported that he would miss at least one week of action.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Charles Bassey is PROBABLE with left toe soreness. He's played in ten straight after missing the first two games of the season. He is averaging 7.6 points, 5.7 rebounds, and 0.5 assists this year.
 Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images
 Jimmy Butler is OUT after undergoing right ACL surgery in January. He is hopeful to return at the beginning of 2027.
 Moses Moody is OUT after undergoing left patellar tendon surgery in March. He is hopeful to return at the end of 2026 or beginning of 2027.
 Kistaps Porzingis is OUT and not with the team as he has stepped away from the sport.
 Brandin Podziemski, Yaxel Lendeborg , and Draymond Green will start for the Warriors. Al Horford started against the Rockets, and De'Anthony Melton or Will Richard could start in place of Curry.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Georges Niang, LJ Cryer, Bassey, and Gui Santos should see minutes off the bench.
 The Warriors are 3rd in offense and 10th in defense.
 San Antonio Spurs Injury Report
 De'Aaron Fox is QUESTIONABLE with left hip soreness. He has yet to miss a game this season. He is averaging 14.2 points, 4.3 rebounds, and 6.2 assists in 12 games.
 Devin Vassell is QUESTIONABLE with left adductor tightness. He's missed the last two games. He's averaging 11.9 points, 3.8 rebounds, and 3.1 assists in ten games this season.
 Tobias Harris is OUT with a left calf strain. He has yet to make his season debut.
 Jayden Quaintance is OUT after undergoing right knee surgery. He has yet to make his NBA debut.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Stephon Castle, Dylan Harper, Julian Champagnie, and Victor Wembanyama will start for the Spurs. Fox will start if he's in the lineup.
 Keldon Johnson, Carter Bryant, Luke Kornet, and Harrison Barnes are their top options off the bench.
 The Spurs have the 4th ranked offense and 5th ranked defense.
